reason: A DSH plugin whose primary purpose is orchestrating an evolving nine-player AI Werewolf game, with stateful role actions, human participation through a local browser panel, and optional image services.

summaries.zh: 一个在 DSH 中编排九人狼人杀对局的插件，支持 AI 玩家、角色行动、跨局经验积累以及本地浏览器面板中的人类玩家参与。
summaries.en: A DSH plugin that orchestrates a nine-player Werewolf game with AI roles, stateful actions, cross-game experience accumulation, and human participation through a local browser panel.

capabilities: Orchestrates a nine-player Werewolf game using multiple AI player agents and a state machine
Runs a local HTTP panel for human participation
Accumulates post-game strategy knowledge in a knowledge base
Optionally analyzes and generates images through configured Zhipu AI services
Writes runtime game and review data to local files
